So long, America.

Taylor Swift enjoyed a girls’ night out in London late Wednesday, making her first public outing since marrying Travis Kelce last month.

The Grammy winner was photographed exiting Annabel’s, a private members-only club, around midnight in a floral purple minidress.

Vogue reported that wedding planner Mark Seed organized the July 3 ceremony at Madison Square Garden, with a guest list of more than 1,000 people. The couple got engaged in August 2025, nearly two years after first appearing publicly together.

Swift was photographed in London in August 2026 debuting a significant new hairstyle — one of her first notable public appearances since the wedding. Kelce's Chiefs press conference marked the first time he addressed the marriage on record.
